# Handoffs

Use this folder for formal cross-agent handoff packets when work leaves one specialist and becomes actionable for another.

Recommended packet shape:

- Title, date, sender, recipient, and related issue or PR.
- Current state and readiness level.
- Deliverables and links.
- Decisions already made.
- Risks, assumptions, and blocked items.
- Exact next actions and acceptance criteria.
- Signature from the sender.

Agent-owned draft work stays in `.github/portfolios/<agent>/`; this folder records the formal transfer between agents.

- Jesse
